Version 1 feels natural — I typed `reference`, hit Enter, and it turned into a little tag chip right next to the existing "web design" one. Adding tags while I'm saving, and letting a tag have spaces, both suit me fine.

One thing that matters to me for tagging: as I start typing a tag, I'd like it to suggest tags I've already used, so I can reuse them instead of accidentally creating slightly-different duplicates. Version 1's chip style is the one I'd pick — I'd just want that suggestion behavior added to it (version 2 hints at showing existing tags, but I prefer the type-and-Enter chip feel of version 1). With that, this works for me.
